approvers: Nobody else; I decide alone, but the glazing subcontractor would have to agree
reason: Glazing damage before handover is the glazing subcontractor's problem, not mine, so I have no budget line for this. At about €19/m² I would be paying for something I can cover with cheap film and tape.
objection: Why would I pay €19 a m² for a coating when the glazing sub carries the risk and film and tape cost me well under €1 a m² in material?
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape, and leave damage to glazing with the glazing subcontractor under their contract.
would_change_my_mind: A glazing subcontractor or developer client who requires it and pays for it, or proof it cuts my own cleaning and defect claims by more than it costs, at a price close to film and tape.
